capacity:caller.title: Decision service can't keep up
capacity:caller.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 400/s and handles 246/s (163%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:caller.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.
